title: Introducing Project EAGLE - Our NEW 5 Second Drag Car

chassis_builder.name: Cameron Johnson Race Cars (CJ Race Cars)
chassis_builder.notes: Cameron built Leroy's exo cage years ago at Profab; shop about an hour from Cleetus' shop; Tye formerly worked there

motivation.fact: Mullet's best stated as 6.30s at 235 mph; car is a compromise of many concepts (jet car, Drag & Drive, race car)
Mullet transmission swap takes ~6 hours just to remove; Eagle trans meant to come out through the door opening, estimated 6-9x easier to work on
Building it in-house would take Tye about a year alone

base_vehicle.construction: built from scratch out of tube/metal, not from a purchased car; steel quarter panels; two-piece hood and two-piece front end
base_vehicle.chassis_material_notes: titanium pieces noted (roll bar / parts), steel elsewhere; caption also says 'all titanium' loosely

engine.notes: Not decided yet; a big-block mock-up was in the chassis but explicitly 'not decided'; 'big horsepower'; Cleetus jokes about 3,000 hp

power_adder.type: twin turbo (stated by Cleetus as concept)

transmission.notes: Bellhousing to suit big block or the '41x' (caption; possibly a specific block) still to be sourced

rear_end.notes: Rear end housing not yet ordered; to be measured after wheels/tires arrive; 'axle, the whole nine yards' pending

suspension.shocks: Menscer shocks ordered (caption 'mener' - corrected, medium confidence)

tires.notes: '275' said while viewing the car - possibly 275 radial reference, low confidence

parts_strategy.fact: Built using as much of the Cleetus/'motion race' (caption) in-house parts catalog as possible

cars.confidence: high for chassis/base/weight estimates; low for engine/power adder (undecided)

facts.fact: Eagle ~1,100 lb lighter than Mullet (implies Mullet ~3,500 lb)
Exo cage built by Cameron Johnson at Profab
El Camino ('3500 El Camino' trying to go 5s called a bad idea); same fabricator worked on it

giveaway_refs.fact: Cleetus store giveaway options: 64 mm turbo, 72 mm turbo or set of tires
